notes.title: Version 1.4.3 Update
notes.notes:
Update featuring bugfixes and minor gameplay adjustments.

Fixed bestiary expansion requirements.

Changed BGE-9 tile palette.

Adjusted Fuse enemy behavior (now slows down after overlapping the player tile e.g. during player jump for more predictable getaway routing).

Adjusted Spitter obstacle animation.

Added minor graphical fixes related to hidden orthographic mode and lightbulbs.

The branch gmvm is also updated. Please report issues you find. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.4.2 Update
notes.notes:
Update featuring bugfixes.

 The crash occuring when Rank Explanation is chosen after Finale is fixed.
 The rare crash occuring when player makes a specific leap down a cracked fragile tile on 9-8 is fixed.
 Superjumping on top of changing X tiles and naval mines instantly KO's the player like when superjumping on top of pink X tiles instead of activating the landing iframes.

The branch gmvm is also updated. Please report issues you find. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.4.1 Update
notes.notes:
Update featuring minor bugfixes and adjustments.

 Level Editor now allows usage of new music tracks (S8 and SX) and new fruits (plum, blackcurrant, pannacotta, tiramisu, dango) introduced in 1.4.
 It's possible to emulate the pre-1.4 jump - this option is only available via config.ini editing in AppData folder (jump_style - change to 0 to activate the legacy jump).
 It's possible to change the size of rendered background to smaller than resolution size, yielding performance gains - this option is only available via config.ini editing in AppData folder (bg_size - change from 1 to 2, 3, 4 to divide the background size).

VM build will come soon.

Please report any issues you might find via Steam community or other methods. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.4, with features previously exclusives to the Nintendo Switch release of VIVIDLOPE, is now available!

 New playable character, Miss Noir! With 4 special abilities unlocked at high Power, she doesn't need a lot of items to pummel things into dust and blaze her way through the stages!
 Cerise now has a Defense Up ability - when she has high Power, she can tank one hit without getting knocked out.
 All 3 playable characters are now available from get-go.
 New and improved jump physics - simpler to understand and more useful. Jump over foes with ease!
 Drop Queue - enemy and item spawns are now easier to read and predict.
 Rebalanced Endless mode - with boosted obstacle variety.
 ...and more!

A version of the game for modding purposes built with GM's VM is available on Steam beta branch gmvm (no password needed). This version is built with fewer optimizations, so it is recommended to only use it if you want to mod the game.

For the purists, legacy version of the game without rebalanced gameplay (1.3.1) is available on the Steam beta branch 1.3.x (no password needed).

Please report any issues you may find via Steam forums. Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 Update
notes.notes: This specific update only contains minor fixes, mainly related to Workshop level compatibility checks.

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
This update introduces Japanese translation of the game, provided by Kurono Studios.

Also comes with several bugfixes.

As usual, please report issues you may find. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.2.2 Update
notes.notes: This patch was made to fix the snake-related crash. Other minor fixes were also added.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Update
notes.notes:
This is an experimental update that comes with major optimizations - framerate will be smoother and loading times a lot shorter.

Aside from that and a few bugfixes, VIVIDCORE/ending cutscenes and credits are now skippable.

Please report any problems you might encounter. In case of major ones (and for modding purposes), 1.2.0 has been made available on a separate branch if you want to roll back.

Thanks for playing, hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.2.0 is here - it's a big update!

 Level editor and Workshop support - now you can download more levels and make your own. Plenty possibilities!
 Bestiary - know your enemy. Learn about the behavior of your foes and play with them without the risk of getting knocked out. Check Extras in main menu to access it.
 New Tile Coloring option - Constant. You can customize it by editing the included png file, too!
 Endless [spoiler]and Gauntlet[/spoiler] mode cutscenes are now viewable in Cinema.
 A lot of new mid-game hints for new players.
 Minor adjustments and bugfixes.

Your controls will be reset after playing the update - note that default camera rotation and equip keys have changed.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
This patch comes with bugfixes.

 One of Ecru's hats is now normally purchasable
 Paint Balloon and Wrap Paper projectiles no longer despawn when using camera actions
 Fixed player getting stuck in place after getting KO'd during kicking a snowman
 Fixed Finale not resetting life counter correctly when entered for the first time
 Fixed certain enemies possibly rendering the stage unwinnable when combined with falling star hazard
 Fixed incorrect key display in BG Viewer
 Possibly fixed a rare stage clear FX bug

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Introducing Easy mode - you can now pick between Easy (new) and Hard (old) difficulty before each stage. Easy reduces the number of enemies and simplifies some of the stage coloring patterns, but also caps out at brand-new S+ rank instead of V rank.

Other worthy mentions:

Random save load crash should be fixed
Steam Cloud saves
Other misc/stage tweaks


Let me know about any bugs you find, I'll fix them ASAP. Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
Important changes:

 Steam Overlay screenshots work again
 Steam Cloud has been enabled (Steam Auto-Cloud)
 Stage adjustments - a lot of Level 9 and Finale stages have been made easier
 Decreased Equip Item prices
 Equip Items can no longer drop the Rank Cap below S
 Bomb can now be purchased as an Equip Item
 Fixed Endless and Gauntlet related crashes/bugs

Unfortunately, the random crash still has not been fixed - apologies for inconveniences related to that, working hard on getting that one done with.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Important changes:

 Fixed crash occurring when using Dash into specific objects
 Fixed crash occurring when player character gets KO'd off the stage at specific points (most easily reproducible by leaping off-stage in 2-14)
 Fixed Steam achievements not registering
 Fixed Spitter enemy's projectiles despawning too early
 Fixed issues with Finale's part 5


Unfortunately, the random crash that occurs when loading a save or starting a new file has not been fixed. If you encounter this issue, try rebooting the game and (optionally) starting an Endless mode run. Any information on more consistent reproduction methods of the issue is appreciated. Apologies for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Demo v. 1.2.1 update!
notes.notes: This update comes with 7 extra stages for more skilled players, it also fixes a couple reported and unreported issues.

notes.title: Demo v. 1.1.0 update!
notes.notes:
This update addresses some of the feedback given by players, including:

Lack of clarity of the ranking system
Ability to speed up the KO animations
Easier to understand Bonus Phase access (the B threshold has been removed)
Other minor stuff

and new music!

notes.title: Demo v. 1.0.1 update!
notes.notes: This update should fix issues related to the game not opening properly for certain players.
